idea-plugin.name: ORA Error Helper
idea-plugin.description:
Explains Oracle ORA-, PLS- and TNS- errors inside the IDE: what the error means, the usual causes and how to fix it. Works offline, needs no database connection, and runs in every JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, DataGrip, PyCharm, Rider, WebStorm...).

  • Explain Oracle Error in the editor and console context menu: put the caret on ORA-01422 or select a line of a log and get the explanation in a popup.
  • ORA Errors tool window: search by code (1403, PLS-306) or by word (mutating, deadlock, snapshot).
  • Practical fixes written for developers: ORA-04091 mutating table, ORA-01555 snapshot too old, ORA-06502 buffer too small, ORA-00942 and role grants in PL/SQL, ORA-12899 and multi-byte character sets, and more.

Free: the 44 most common errors, one code at a time.

Pro (licence or free trial): the full catalogue of 250+ ORA and PLS errors, and explanation of a whole stack trace at once (select it or copy it to the clipboard). The entries are written by the author, not copied from Oracle documentation.
